description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes StatefulSet resources, including create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, apply, and scale operations.

classes.name: statefulSets
classes.description: Implementation of the StatefulSetInterface for managing StatefulSet resources within a namespace.

methods.name: GetScale
methods.description: Retrieves the scale subresource for a specified StatefulSet.

methods.name: UpdateScale
methods.description: Updates the scale subresource for a specified StatefulSet.

methods.name: ApplyScale
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the scale subresource of a StatefulSet.
